**Experimental.** The optional PC/FCI/GES wrappers operate on module averages
from caller-supplied selected items. They return candidate skeletons, direction
labels and bootstrap summaries; they are not the Core DAG validity check.

Forbidden adjacencies constrain skeletons. Theory tiers provide post-hoc
direction annotations, not general search-direction constraints. Matrix
orientation interpretation remains experimental. NOTEARS is Not Implemented.
No structural-learning experiment is executed in this vignette; the Core
synthetic workflow does not depend on these backends.
